Jerusalem Artichokes In Cream
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




2 pounds Jerusalem artichokes, boiled
1 tablespoon Unsalted butter
1/2 cup Heavy cream
Salt and black pepper

Preparation

1 Artichokes should be boiled until just tender (about 10 m inutes). As soon as they are just tender, drain and quickly peel them. You may let tghem cook just enough to handle, but don't let them get cold, and under no circumstances should you put them in cold water to hasten their cooling. 2 Wipe and dry the kettle that they were boiled in and put in the whole artichokes, the butter, and the cream. Return to medium heat. Cook, tossing them frequently until the cream has thickened and lightly coats the vegetables, about 3 to 4 minutes. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Transfer to a warm serving dish and serve at opnce.
